To read emotion, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Document the specific micro-expressions observed (5 minutes)
Step 2. Synthesize all non-verbal cues into a final emotional profile (10 minutes)
Step 3. Analyze the pitch and tone of the subject's voice (3 minutes)
Step 4. Establish a baseline for the subject's neutral behavior (1 hour)
Step 5. Evaluate the physiological response such as pupil dilation (2 minutes)
Step 6. Categorize the emotion as primary or secondary (4 minutes)

Step 17. Note any discrepancies between speech and gesture (5 minutes)

Step 35. Transcribe the verbal content of the interaction (1 hour)

Step 37. Set up the observation laboratory (2 hours)
Step 38. Calculate the probability of emotional deception (12 minutes)
Step 39. Analyze the specific word choices and metaphors used (25 minutes)

To move to ohio, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Research neighborhoods in Columbus and Cleveland (1 week)
Step 2. Schedule a walkthrough with a real estate agent (3 days)
Step 3. Request official transcripts for school transfers (2 weeks)
Step 4. Determine a total relocation budget (4 hours)
Step 5. Transfer car insurance to the new state (1 hour)
Step 6. Hire a professional moving company (2 days)
Step 7. Redirect mail via the postal service website (15 minutes)
Step 8. Obtain a pre-approval letter from the bank (5 days)
Step 9. Catalog high-value items for insurance (6 hours)
Step 10. List the current house on the market (1 week)
Step 11. Pack up the kitchen and dining room (2 days)
Step 12. Conduct a deep clean of the current residence (2 days)
Step 13. Submit a formal rental application or purchase offer (24 hours)
Step 14. Gather original birth certificates and social security cards (2 hours)
Step 15. Save up for a security deposit and first month's rent (3 months)
Step 16. Browse online real estate listings (10 hours)
Step 17. Purchase heavy-duty moving boxes and tape (2 hours)
Step 18. Donate unwanted furniture to charity (4 hours)
Step 19. Register to vote in the new Ohio county (30 minutes)
Step 20. Load the moving truck (8 hours)
Step 21. Sort clothes into "keep" and "toss" piles (1 day)
Step 22. Interview local Ohio property managers (4 days)
Step 23. Notify current employer of resignation (2 weeks)
Step 24. Research Ohio utility providers (3 hours)
Step 25. Sign the new lease or closing papers (2 hours)
Step 26. Wrap fragile glassware in bubble wrap (5 hours)
Step 27. Cancel local gym memberships and club subscriptions (1 hour)
Step 28. Verify move-in dates with the landlord (1 hour)
Step 29. Disconnect the internet and cable service (30 minutes)
Step 30. Set aside a "first night" suitcase with essentials (3 hours)
Step 31. Decide on a target move-in month (2 days)
Step 32. Schedule a utility connection for the new address (1 hour)
Step 33. Conduct a final walkthrough of the new property (3 hours)
Step 34. Apply for a new job in Ohio (1 month)
Step 35. Review the terms of the relocation contract (5 hours)
Step 36. Organize a folder with all moving receipts (1 hour)
Step 37. Compare quotes from different moving truck rentals (1 day)
Step 38. Take photos of the apartment for the security deposit return (2 hours)
Step 39. Update the address on your driver's license (1 hour)
Step 40. Pick up the keys to the new Ohio home (15 minutes)

To make a chipmunk puppet from a glove, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Purchase a brown wool glove (45 minutes)
Step 2. Sketch the chipmunk facial features on paper (10 minutes)
Step 3. Prepare the sewing needle and brown thread (5 minutes)
Step 4. Cut the pinky and thumb off the glove (10 minutes)
Step 5. Turn the glove inside out (2 minutes)
Step 6. Embroider the tiny black nose (15 minutes)
Step 7. Select felt scraps for the ears (5 minutes)
Step 8. Stitch the holes where fingers were removed (20 minutes)
Step 9. Find two small black beads for eyes (5 minutes)
Step 10. Lay out all crafting materials on the table (5 minutes)
Step 11. Trim excess thread from the seams (3 minutes)
Step 12. Cut two ear shapes from the felt (8 minutes)
Step 13. Cut a small white patch for the belly (4 minutes)
Step 14. Mark eye placement with a chalk pencil (2 minutes)
Step 15. Cut a small piece of cardboard for the mouth support (6 minutes)
Step 16. Sew the ears onto the top of the glove (12 minutes)
Step 17. Sew the bead eyes onto the fabric (15 minutes)
Step 18. Stitch a small smile onto the face (10 minutes)
Step 19. Stuff the head section with cotton batting (10 minutes)
Step 20. Glue a small pom-pom tail to the back (5 minutes)
Step 21. Draw the chipmunk stripes on the back with a marker (10 minutes)
Step 22. Hand-wash the puppet to remove chalk marks (15 minutes)
Step 23. Add a small acorn accessory to the hand (5 minutes)
Step 24. Thread a decorative ribbon for a collar (2 minutes)
Step 25. Heat up the hot glue gun (10 minutes)
Step 26. Paint white accents on the stripes (15 minutes)
Step 27. Knot the ribbon around the neck (3 minutes)
Step 28. Inspect the puppet for loose threads (5 minutes)
Step 29. Spray the puppet with fabric protector (1 hour)
Step 30. Insert the cardboard support into the mouth area (4 minutes)
Step 31. Research chipmunk puppet designs online (30 minutes)
Step 32. Let the stuffing settle and fluff the fabric (20 minutes)
Step 33. Secure the white belly patch with fabric glue (8 minutes)
Step 34. Detail the paws with dark embroidery thread (25 minutes)
Step 35. Apply a small amount of pink blush to the cheeks (2 minutes)
Step 36. Cut a small piece of faux fur for the tail (7 minutes)
Step 37. Position the white belly patch (3 minutes)
Step 38. Pin the ears in place for alignment (4 minutes)
Step 39. Apply a clear coat to the painted stripes (20 minutes)
Step 40. Sew the edges of the eye beads for extra security (10 minutes)
